name: One Wild Futa Nightclub
summary:
You are living an ordinary life when a hot new neighbor moves into the apartment across from you. Her name is Mia, and apparently she is some kind of important scientist, but that doesn’t really matter to you. That is until you get caught up in one of her crazy experiments!

Now you find yourself stuck in Mia’s body, as the experiment is apparently not going as planned. However, Mia is confident that she can return you both back to your original bodies, but it will take her some time. Time, that you can use to explore your new, if only temporary, body. This is when you meet one of Mia’s friends, who is determined to bring you out clubbing with her. Not having the social skills to refuse the extrovert, you find yourself dressing up and going out to the club.
